# Barishamlai — Building Management System

> A web application for managing residential apartment buildings in Bangladesh. Handles rent collection, service charges, gas bills, expenses, and tenant management.

## Pages

- [Home](https://barishamlai.com/): Landing page with product overview
- [Blog](https://barishamlai.com/blog): Articles on building management best practices
- [About](https://barishamlai.com/about): About the platform
- [Contact](https://barishamlai.com/contact): Contact information
- [Privacy Policy](https://barishamlai.com/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://barishamlai.com/terms): Terms of service

## Dashboard (Private — Login Required)

The /dashboard area requires authentication. It includes:
- Rent management (per-unit billing, payment tracking)
- Service charge management (fund tracking, expense categories)
- Gas bill management (unit consumption, cylinder purchases)
- Expense tracking by category
- Tenant and unit management
- Financial reports and fund summaries
- Building configuration and onboarding

## Notes

- Dashboard routes are private and require authentication
- Supported roles: Admin, President, Secretary, Tenant
- Supports bilingual interface (English and Bengali)
